TaskResume（任务恢复）\n   530→    TaskResume {\n   531→        timestamp: u64,\n   532→        thread_id: u64,\n   533→        transaction_id: TxnIndex,\n   534→        incarnation: Incarnation,\n   535→ },\n   539→}\n   540→\n   541→/// Log file types - Enhanced 8-category classification\n   542→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Eq, Hash, PartialEq)]\n   543→pub enum LogFileType {\n   544→    BlockSummary,      // BlockStart/Finish, SchedulerSample, MemoryUsageSnapshot\n   545→    SchedulerStates,   // SchedulerStateTransition, TaskPicked/Finished, LockContention\n   546→    MVHashMapOps,      // MVRead/Write, EstimateMark/Clear\n   547→    Dependencies,      // DependencyBlock/Resolve, StallPropagation\n   548→    ExecutionFlow,     // ExecutionStart/Finish, ValidationStart/Finish, DelayedFieldOperation, ResourceGroupOperation, ReadWriteSetChange\n   551→    SystemOperations,  // ModuleCacheOperation, EventEmission, PerformanceMetric\n   552→}\n   553→\n   554→impl LogFileType {\n   555→    fn filename(&self) -> &'static str {\n   556→        match self {\n   557→            LogFileType::BlockSummary => \"block_summary.ndjson\",\n   558→            LogFileType::SchedulerStates => \"scheduler_states.ndjson\",\n   559→            LogFileType::MVHashMapOps => \"mvhashmap_ops.ndjson\",\n   560→            LogFileType::Dependencies => \"dependencies.ndjson\",\n   561→            LogFileType::ExecutionFlow => \"execution_flow.ndjson\",\n   562→            LogFileType::AbortRecovery => \"abort_recovery.ndjson\",\n   563→            LogFileType::DetailedOperations => \"detailed_operations.ndjson\",\n   564→            LogFileType::SystemOperations => \"system_operations.ndjson\",\n   565→        }\n   566→    }\n   567→}\n   568→\n   569→/// Thread-safe logger for Block-STM events\n   570→pub struct BlockSTMLogger {\n   571→    config: LoggingConfig,\n   572→    writers: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<LogFileType, BufWriter<File>>>>,\n   573→    _start_time: Instant,\n   574→}\n   575→\n   576→impl BlockSTMLogger {\n   577→    /// Create a new logger with the given configuration\n   578→    pub fn new(config: LoggingConfig) -> std::io::Result<Self> {\n   579→        if !config.enabled {\n   580→            return Ok(Self {\n   581→                config,\n   582→                writers: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),\n   583→                _start_time: Instant::now(),\n   584→            });\n   585→        }\n   586→\n   587→        // Create log directory if it doesn't exist\n   588→        std::fs::create_dir_all(&config.log_dir)?;\n   589→\n   590→        let mut writers = HashMap::new();\n   591→        \n   592→        // Initialize all log files\n   593→        for file_type in [\n   594→            LogFileType::BlockSummary,\n   595→            LogFileType::SchedulerStates,\n   596→            LogFileType::MVHashMapOps,\n   597→            LogFileType::Dependencies,\n   598→            LogFileType::ExecutionFlow,\n   599→            LogFileType::AbortRecovery,\n   600→            LogFileType::DetailedOperations,\n   601→            LogFileType::SystemOperations,\n   602→        ] {\n   603→            let file_path = config.log_dir.join(file_type.filename());\n   604→            let file = OpenOptions::new()\n   605→                .create(true)\n   606→                .append(true)\n   607→                .open(file_path)?;\n   608→            let writer = BufWriter::with_capacity(config.buffer_size, file);\n   609→            writers.insert(file_type, writer);\n   610→        }\n   611→\n   612→        Ok(Self {\n   613→            config,\n   614→            writers: Arc::new(Mutex::new(writers)),\n   615→            _start_time: Instant::now(),\n   616→        })\n   617→    }\n   618→\n   619→    /// Create a logger with default configuration\n   620→    pub fn with_default_config() -> std::io::Result<Self> {\n   621→        Self::new(LoggingConfig::default())\n   622→    }\n   623→\n   624→\n   625→    /// Log an event to the appropriate file\n   626→    pub fn log_event(&self, event: LogEvent, level: LogLevel) {\n   627→        if !self.config.enabled || level < self.config.log_level {\n   628→            return;\n   629→        }\n   630→\n   631→        let file_type = match &event {\n   632→            // BlockSummary: BlockStart/Finish, SchedulerSample, MemoryUsageSnapshot\n   633→            LogEvent::BlockStart { .. }\n   634→            | LogEvent::BlockFinish { .. }\n   635→            | LogEvent::SchedulerSample { .. }\n   636→            | LogEvent::MemoryUsageSnapshot { .. } => LogFileType::BlockSummary,\n   637→            \n   638→            // SchedulerStates: SchedulerStateTransition, TaskPicked/Finished, TaskSuspend/Resume, LockContention\n   639→            LogEvent::SchedulerStateTransition { .. }\n   640→            | LogEvent::TaskPicked { .. }\n   641→            | LogEvent::TaskFinished { .. }\n   642→            | LogEvent::TaskSuspend { .. }\n   643→            | LogEvent::TaskResume { .. }\n   644→            | LogEvent::LockContention { .. } => LogFileType::SchedulerStates,\n   645→            \n   646→            // MVHashMapOps: MVRead/Write, EstimateMark/Clear\n   647→            LogEvent::MVRead { .. }\n   648→            | LogEvent::MVWrite { .. }\n   649→            | LogEvent::EstimateMark { .. }\n   650→            | LogEvent::EstimateClear { .. } => LogFileType::MVHashMapOps,\n   651→            \n   652→            // Dependencies: DependencyBlock/Resolve, StallPropagation\n   653→            LogEvent::DependencyBlock { .. }\n   654→            | LogEvent::DependencyResolve { .. }\n   655→            | LogEvent::StallPropagation { .. } => LogFileType::Dependencies,\n   656→            \n   657→            // ExecutionFlow: ExecutionStart/Finish, ValidationStart/Finish, TransactionOutputDetail\n   658→            LogEvent::ExecutionStart { .. }\n   659→            | LogEvent::ExecutionFinish { .. }\n   660→            | LogEvent::ValidationStart { .. }\n   661→            | LogEvent::ValidationFinish { .. }\n   662→            | LogEvent::TransactionOutputDetail { .. } => LogFileType::ExecutionFlow,\n   663→            \n   664→            // AbortRecovery: AbortInitiated, IncarnationIncrement, RescheduleHigher, ValidationConflict\n   665→            LogEvent::AbortInitiated { .. }\n   666→            | LogEvent::IncarnationIncrement { .. }\n   667→            | LogEvent::RescheduleHigher { .. }\n   668→            | LogEvent::ValidationConflict { .. } => LogFileType::AbortRecovery,\n   669→            \n   670→            // DetailedOperations: AggregatorOperation, DelayedFieldOperation, ResourceGroupOperation, ReadWriteSetChange\n   671→            LogEvent::AggregatorOperation { .. }\n   672→            | LogEvent::DelayedFieldOperation { .. }\n   673→            | LogEvent::ResourceGroupOperation { .. }\n   674→            | LogEvent::ReadWriteSetChange { .. } => LogFileType::DetailedOperations,\n   675→            \n   676→            // SystemOperations: ModuleCacheOperation, EventEmission, PerformanceMetric\n   677→            LogEvent::ModuleCacheOperation { .. }\n   678→            | LogEvent::EventEmission { .. }\n   679→            | LogEvent::PerformanceMetric { .. } => LogFileType::SystemOperations,\n   680→        };\n   681→\n   682→        if let Ok(mut writers) = self.writers.lock() {\n   683→            if let Some(writer) = writers.get_mut(&file_type) {\n   684→                if let Ok(json_str) = serde_json::to_string(&event) {\n   685→                    let _ = writeln!(writer, \"{}\", json_str);\n   686→                    let _ = writer.flush();\n   687→                }\n   688→            }\n   689→        }\n   690→    }\n   691→\n   692→    // === Block lifecycle events ===\n   693→    \n build_profile: &str,\n   706→    ) {\n   707→        let event = LogEvent::BlockStart {\n   708→            timestamp: Self::current_timestamp_us(),\n   709→            thread_id: 0,\n   710→ };\n   741→        self.log_event(event, LogLevel::Info);\n   742→    }\n   743→\n   744→    /// Log scheduler sample event\n   745→    pub fn log_scheduler_sample(\n   746→        &self,\n   747→ };\n   772→        self.log_event(event, LogLevel::Debug);\n   773→    }\n   774→\n   775→    // === Scheduler state transitions ===\n   776→\n   777→    /// Log scheduler state transition\n   778→ If a transaction T_i is stalled (e.g.,\n    50→        because a lower-indexed transaction T_j it depends on was aborted and T_j might\n    51→        abort T_i again), T_i's re-execution might be deferred. A lock (`queueing_commits_lock`) is used to serialize\n    58→    the dispatching of sequential commit hooks. [SchedulerV2]\n    89→    consumes the [AbortManager] to finalize these aborts and update dependencies.\n    90→-   **Worker Threads**: Continuously request tasks from [SchedulerV2] via [SchedulerV2::next_task].\n    91→    They execute these tasks and report results (e.g., via [SchedulerV2::finish_execution],\n    92→    [SchedulerV2::end_commit]).\n    93→\n    94→Conceptual Execution Model:\n    95→--------------------------\n    96→Workers request tasks. [SchedulerV2] prioritizes:\n    97→1.  **Post-Commit Processing Tasks**: If there are transactions that have been committed and\n    98→    are awaiting their parallel post-commit logic, these are dispatched first. If all work is done or the scheduler is halted, `Done` is returned.\n   105→\n   106→The design aims to maximize parallelism while ensuring correctness through careful management\n   107→of dependencies, aborts, and commit sequencing. The stall mechanism is a best-effort\n   108→heuristic to reduce wasted work from cascading aborts.\n   109→**/\n   110→\n   111→/// Manages push-invalidations caused by a transaction's output and handles aborting dependent transactions.\n   112→///\n   113→/// [AbortManager] is a non-Sync struct designed for a worker executing a particular transaction\n   114→/// (the \"owner transaction\", identified by `owner_txn_idx` and `owner_incarnation`).\n   115→/// When the owner transaction finishes execution, its writes might necessitate the re-execution\n   116→/// of other transactions that read the same data locations. DependencyBlocked（数据层依赖阻塞）\n    DependencyBlocked {\n        timestamp: u64,\n        thread_id: u64,\n        dependent_tx: TxnIndex,\n        on_tx: TxnIndex,                // 所依赖的上游交易\n        reason: String,                 // \"EstimateRead\"|\"InFlightWrite\"\n        state_key: Option<String>,\n    },\n\n    // 48. DependencyUnblocked（数据层依赖解除）\n    DependencyUnblocked {\n        timestamp: u64,\n        thread_id: u64,\n        dependent_tx: TxnIndex,\n        on_tx: TxnIndex,\n        reason: String,                 // \"Committed\"|\"Aborted\"|\"Executed\"\n        wait_time_us: u64,\n    },\n\n    // 49. MVReadV2（扩展的MV读操作）\n    MVReadV2 {\n        timestamp: u64,\n        thread_id: u64,\n        transaction_id: TxnIndex,\n        incarnation: Incarnation,\n        key: String,\n        source: String,                  // \"Committed\"|\"EstimateOf(tx)\"|\"Storage\"|\"NotFound\"\n        result: String,                  // \"Ok\"|\"Dependency\"\n        writer_tx: Option<TxnIndex>,\n        writer_incarnation: Option<Incarnation>,\n        value_size: Option<usize>,\n    },"

or IsSafe dependency status).\n                status.swap_dependency_status_any(\n                    &[DependencyStatus::ShouldDefer, DependencyStatus::IsSafe],\n                    DependencyStatus::IsSafe,\n                    \"remove_stall\",\n                )?;\n            }\n            return Ok(true);\n        }\n        Ok(false)\n    }\n    /// Attempts to transition a transaction from PendingScheduling to Executing state.\n    ///\n    /// This method is called by the scheduler when it selects a transaction for execution.\n    /// It only succeeds if the       "new_string": "    pub(crate) fn remove_stall(&self, txn_idx: TxnIndex, owner_txn: TxnIndex) -> Result<bool, PanicError> {\n        let status = &self.statuses[txn_idx as usize];\n        let prev_num_stalls = status.num_stalls.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n        let current_stall_count = prev_num_stalls.saturating_sub(1);\n        let became_unstalled = prev_num_stalls == 1;\n\n        if prev_num_stalls == 0 {\n            return Err(code_invariant_error(\n                \"remove_stall called when num_stalls == 0\",\n            ));\n        }\n\n        // Log StallRemove event\n        if let Some(logger) = get_global_logger() {\n            let status_guard = status.status_with_incarnation.lock();\n            let incarnation = status_guard.incarnation();\n            logger.log_stall_remove(txn_idx, incarnation, owner_txn, current_stall_count, became_unstalled);\n            drop(status_guard); // Release early to avoid holding lock too long\n        }\n\n        if prev_num_stalls == 1 {\n            // Acquire write lock for (non-monitor) shortcut modifications.\n            let status_guard = status.status_with_incarnation.lock();\n\n            // num_stalls updates are not under the lock, so need to re-check (otherwise\n            // a different add_stall might have already incremented the count).\n            if status.is_stalled() {\n                return Ok(false);\n            }"

/// Update maximum concurrent executions\n    pub fn update_max_concurrent_executions(&self, current_concurrent: u32) {\n        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;\n        let mut current_max = self.execution_stats.max_concurrent_executions.load(Ordering::Relaxed);\n        while current_concurrent > current_max {\n            match   self.execution_stats.total_reexecutions.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Increment commit marker transitions\n    pub fn increment_commit_marker_transitions(&self) {\n        self.execution_stats.commit_marker_transitions.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);\n    }\n\n    /// Increment post-commit tasks   }\n    }"
